Captured 2026-11-25 in 30-day Developer scratch orgs with Communities enabled.
Internal sharing models were deployed for Case and Lead with no external model.
Only observations whose EntityDefinition confirmed the internal model and Private
external sharing are recorded. Scratch orgs were deleted after the captures.
The administrator gained a role before creating two Cases and one Lead. The
Standard User and the Community reader were inserted in a separate transaction.
The named Guest was created by deploying the inactive Synthetic CustomSite
from the external_guest_case_lead_access fixture. The local replay creates the
equivalent unprivileged user on the Sites-seeded Guest profile.
At APIs 62.0 and 67.0, capture and replay query directly as the administrator
with one named UserId and one RecordId. The three cells represent an unrelated
Case, a Case linked to the Community reader's contact, and an unrelated Lead.
A dash denotes zero rows. A pair denotes the read and edit bits of one row.
NEIGHBOR PROBES
API 68.0 and the projection with an added HasDeleteAccess field keep their
prior missing rows. Private Case still has no anonymous named Community row.
Anonymous execution as the external actor is a different
route. The existing IsTest fixtures cover System.runAs and describe.
